name: Kosuge Nao
source:
A slightly out-of-focus honor student trying her best

She is the first girl at Sakurai Academy that Kazuhiro met after completing the transfer procedures. She showed him around the academy. Although she has a slightly off-kilter sensibility, she has an extremely kind personality, and loves doing all kinds of housework and playing with children. She is a hard worker who handles a variety of tasks without complaint, but it is hard to shake the impression that she is being taken advantage of by some of the teachers. Although she just wants everyone to be happy, some of her classmates seem to find her behavior annoying. She has excellent grades and attends Sakurai Academy as a scholarship student. This may also be the reason why some people envy her.
